tool.name: Permeation Flux Calculator
tool.description: Compute downstream gas flow rate from FEM diffusion solution

param.name: mesh_d
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: Modified .d file from Diffusivity Field tool (with per-element material IDs)

param.name: mat_file
param.label: Diffusivity field (.mat)
param.help: .mat file from Diffusivity Field tool — per-element D values

param.name: axis
param.label: Permeation axis
param.help: Axis along which hydrogen permeates through the membrane

param.name: temp_ambient
param.label: Gas measurement temperature (K)
param.help: Temperature at which the gas flow is measured (usually room temperature ~298 K). Used to convert mol/s to Pa.m3/s and mbar.L/s.

tool.help:
Computes the downstream gas permeation flux at every simulated timestep from a FEM diffusion solution (steady-state or transient).
The flux is integrated as J = -D * dC/dn over all elements on the downstream face at each output step, giving a time series of molar flow rate in mol/s. For steady-state inputs the output is a single-row CSV.
**Inputs**
- Mesh (.d): the modified mesh from the Diffusivity Field tool - Concentration field: EnSight tarball from the diffusion solver - Diffusivity (.mat): per-element D(T) field from the Diffusivity Field tool
**Downstream face**
Set Permeation axis and Downstream face to match your mesh orientation. For a membrane aligned along Z with the high-pressure face at z=0 and the low-pressure (vacuum) face at z=L, use axis=Z and face=Maximum.
**Output**
A CSV with one row per output timestep containing:
- step: EnSight file step number - time_s: simulation time (s) - flux_mol_s: total molar flow rate (mol/s) - flux_pa_m3_s: flow rate in Pa.m3/s - flux_mbar_l_s: flow rate in mbar.L/s (for comparison with mass spectrometer) - flux_density_mol_m2_s: flux normalised by downstream face area (mol/m2/s)
